description: Portugal’s Directorate-General for Territory publishes the 2018 Carta de Areas Edificadas for mainland Portugal. It distinguishes residential concentrations, dispersed residential areas and non-residential built areas, using national building and land-cover sources. The resource supports stock and exposure context. Classification thresholds describe mapped areas, not a count or condition assessment of every building. Published by Direção-Geral do Território. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider page is the access route; underlying file formats were not confirmed.
